business_and_profit_drivers: Cloud-computing infrastructure remains the principal growth engine, with AI servers, GPU/ASIC systems and next-generation cloud-service-provider products increasing the value content per rack and per system.
High-speed networking, including 800G-and-above products, and liquid-cooling integration can raise mix quality and deepen hyperscaler wallet share.

The 2026H1 earnings acceleration is supported by very strong AI-infrastructure demand rather than price momentum alone: reported revenue was RMB557.861bn, attributable net profit RMB23.740bn and diluted/basic EPS RMB1.20.

Customer concentration and hyperscaler capital-expenditure cycles remain the most important external risks; the investment case therefore requires sustained order conversion, margin discipline and cash conversion rather than simply extrapolating AI-theme valuation.

Capital efficiency improved materially with 2026H1 weighted-average ROE of 13.36%, while operating cash flow recovered sharply year on year; nevertheless the low-margin manufacturing model means valuation should remain anchored to normalized EPS and return on capital rather than revenue growth alone.

financial_quality.judgment: Earnings have materially caught up with the share-price rerating. The current valuation still embeds sustained AI-infrastructure growth, but the latest primary financial evidence is strong enough that valuation exhaustion alone does not justify a trim.

thesis.core: Industrial Fulian remains a high-quality AI-infrastructure manufacturing and systems-integration beneficiary. The decisive fresh-D2 change is that 2026H1 earnings growth has partially caught up with the prior share-price rerating, so the old valuation-exhaustion trigger no longer implies an automatic reduction.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market is correctly paying for a structurally larger AI-server opportunity, but not every increment of revenue deserves the same multiple. The holding remains attractive only if AI-server/networking mix sustains normalized EPS around the refreshed base case while capital returns and cash conversion remain disciplined.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Bear/base/bull normalized EPS of RMB2.20/RMB2.70/RMB3.20. Base does not mechanically annualize 2026H1 EPS; it assumes a strong H2 but allows for mix, margin and working-capital normalization.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: 2026H1 EPS of RMB1.20 supports a material upward reset versus the prior underwriting, but the base case does not simply double H1 because mix, margins, customer capex and working-capital intensity can normalize.

underwriting.position_rationale: Expected return is positive but no longer large enough for an ADD. Fundamental acceleration is strong enough that trimming solely because the share price rose would be premature.
catalysts: AI servers and next-generation hyperscaler products continue to scale through 2026H2 with order conversion broadly consistent with current demand signals.
800G-and-above networking and liquid-cooling products increase system value content and support mix quality.
Hyperscaler AI capital expenditure remains elevated and broadens beyond a narrow set of accelerator platforms.
Operating cash conversion and return on capital remain consistent with the higher normalized earnings base.
kill_thesis: Hyperscaler AI capital expenditure enters a sustained contraction that causes material order or utilization deterioration.
Industrial Fulian loses material share or strategic relevance with core AI-server/cloud customers.
Revenue remains strong but gross/operating margin and cash conversion deteriorate persistently enough that normalized EPS cannot sustain roughly RMB2.4-2.5 or better.
The market continues to capitalize the company at an AI-growth premium while evidence no longer supports the refreshed earnings base.

d2_answers.question: Has the current valuation already exhausted the fundamental improvement?
d2_answers.judgment: NO. Valuation margin is narrower than before, but 2026H1 earnings materially caught up with the rerating; fresh probability-weighted value is RMB73.05 versus the RMB66.57 mark.

d2_answers.question: Should normalized earnings be raised?
d2_answers.judgment: YES. Base normalized EPS is reset to RMB2.70, but H1 EPS is not mechanically doubled.

d2_answers.question: Does AI-server/cloud-capex/customer/margin/ROIC evidence support the current price?
d2_answers.judgment: YES_FOR_HOLD_NOT_ADD. Current evidence supports a continued holding, but the remaining expected return is insufficient for new capital.

d2_answers.question: Final portfolio decision?
d2_answers.judgment: HOLD. Do not trim solely because price appreciated; do not add at the current mark.

records.first_rejection_test: NOT_TRIGGERED_FOR_HOLD; reopen TRIM_OR_EXIT if normalized EPS/cash conversion materially breaks below the refreshed base or AI-capex/customer evidence weakens structurally.

records.source_quality_note: Financial facts use the latest 2026H1 primary disclosure; price is bound to the latest completed-session production mark used by current lifecycle. Scenario EPS, multiples and probabilities are analyst assumptions and authorize no trade.

business_and_profit_drivers: Industrial automation and digitalization remain the core quality franchise, supported by broad servo, inverter, PLC, motion-control and industrial digitalization capabilities across many OEM and process-industry verticals.
Share gains and product expansion in industrial automation can compound through the cycle, but the current underwriting must distinguish structural share gain from a simple OEM-cycle rebound.

New-energy-vehicle powertrain products provide a second large growth leg but currently carry materially lower margins than industrial automation, creating mix dilution and execution risk even when revenue grows quickly.
Robotics and digital-energy businesses add optionality but should not be capitalized aggressively before their earnings and cash contribution becomes material.
Cash conversion is a key gating variable because 2026H1 operating cash flow weakened relative to profit even as revenue continued to grow.

financial_quality.judgment: The core industrial-automation franchise remains strong, but mix dilution from NEV and weaker cash conversion mean the old RMB59 ADD threshold no longer provides a sufficient decision-grade margin of safety.

thesis.core: Inovance remains one of China's highest-quality industrial-automation compounders, with durable share-gain potential and multiple adjacent growth vectors. The fresh-D2 issue is valuation discipline: price has reopened the old entry threshold, but current earnings quality does not justify treating that old threshold as an automatic ADD signal.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market may focus on resilient top-line growth and long-duration automation substitution. Fresh underwriting gives more weight to NEV margin dilution and cash conversion, so the company remains a HOLD at RMB58.90 but requires a lower fresh ADD hurdle.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Bear/base/bull normalized EPS of RMB1.80/RMB2.25/RMB2.70. Base assumes industrial-automation share gains and eventual NEV margin normalization without capitalizing a full cyclical or robotics/digital-energy upside case.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: The base retains structural automation share gains but discounts current NEV margin dilution and weaker cash conversion. The old RMB59 threshold is superseded rather than mechanically reused.

underwriting.position_rationale: The existing holding remains justified by the quality and duration of the automation franchise, but the current mark offers only mid-to-high-single-digit probability-weighted upside and therefore does not clear a fresh ADD hurdle.
catalysts: Industrial-automation OEM demand recovers while servo, inverter, PLC and motion-control products continue gaining share.
Pricing, procurement and scale restore NEV gross margin without sacrificing strategic customer penetration.
Robotics and digital-energy businesses reach material scale with acceptable margins and return on invested capital.
Operating cash flow again tracks or exceeds earnings as receivables and inventory normalize.
kill_thesis: Industrial-automation demand weakens while market-share gains stall or reverse across core servo/inverter/PLC categories.
NEV gross margin remains structurally near the low-teens level or deteriorates further without a credible path to higher return on capital.
Working-capital absorption keeps operating cash flow materially below earnings for a sustained period.
Normalized EPS cannot recover toward roughly RMB2.2 or better while the market continues to assign a premium compounder multiple.

d2_answers.question: Does the current price recreate sufficient margin of safety?
d2_answers.judgment: NO_FOR_ADD. RMB58.90 is below the old RMB59 threshold but fresh PWV is only RMB63.45, leaving roughly 7.7% expected return.

d2_answers.question: Do industrial automation, servo and NEV fundamentals support future earnings growth?
d2_answers.judgment: YES_WITH_QUALITY_CAVEATS. Automation remains structurally attractive; NEV margin dilution and cash conversion prevent a stronger underwriting conclusion today.

d2_answers.question: Has normalized earnings changed materially versus old research?
d2_answers.judgment: YES. The fresh base is reset around RMB2.25 normalized EPS and the old price threshold is explicitly superseded.

d2_answers.question: Final portfolio decision?
d2_answers.judgment: HOLD. ADD only if a fresh decision process sees price around or below RMB52.9 or fundamentals materially improve enough to raise PWV.

records.first_rejection_test: ADD_GATE_NOT_CLEARED; HOLD thesis remains valid but new capital requires roughly 20% probability-weighted upside or a material earnings/cash-quality upgrade.
